method: Read the current verifiers, their committed reports and the retained inputs, observed the absent guards on the baseline revision, then ran the hardened verifier suites and the four declared acceptance commands in a clone of that revision. No capture was rerun: the selected archive, the second support-statement SDK and the native KVM image are absent from this host.

D1.finding: source capture/resume trusted an incomplete record
changes: sdk_binding also binds tools/lib, so the compiler, runtime and import/tool closure is complete
helper_sources binds this runner plus m7_021_linux_release, m11_004_installed_consumers, m11_003_native_websocket and evidence_digest
EXPECTED_COMMANDS pins all 39 source commands and their exit codes, including exit 1 for missing-explicit-ca, incorrect-explicit-ca, system-ca-missing and system-ca-incorrect
every command is checked against its declared cwd and argv, so an ID alone cannot carry another command's output
verify_command_inventory rejects duplicate, incomplete, timed-out, reclassified and unsatisfied native outcomes and re-hashes every retained log
each CA scenario's retained stdout must still match that scenario's diagnostic, and the diagnostics may not move to stderr
acceptance evidence is read through the command record's own stdout path instead of a fixed filename
resume revalidates the retained command logs, retained consumer binaries, helper closure and TLS fixture material before reusing them
native_compiler raises a controlled error when cc is unavailable instead of digesting a nonexistent path

the deployment collector resolves the native compiler through native_compiler_digest(), so an absent cc is a controlled error instead of a TypeError from Path(None) while binding a retained source profile

D2.finding: binary matrix and scan inputs did not form a complete evidence chain
changes: validate_abi_matrix requires the complete built/runtime Cartesian product exactly once in addition to passing cells
scan_fields is the single derivation shared by capture and verification, so every ELF, loader, version and ISA verdict is recomputed from the bound scanner output
scanner_digest binds the scanner implementation, and helper_sources binds the imported helpers
verify_consumers requires exactly stable-native and candidate-native for cli, decoded, streams, service and trust with the ten compiled optional archives
--consumer takes a strict <profile>/<app>=<path> identity and is required for every declared coordinate

install_selected_archive replaces any previous attempt's work/install and work/wirestack and returns the tree it extracted, and verify rebinds the reported payload to the selected archive, so a repeated capture cannot scan or validate a stale installation

the deployment collector compares a retained profile's production key set with release.production_sources(ROOT) before comparing bytes, so a profile cannot qualify by dropping or substituting a source

D3.finding: native-platform PASS did not prove the claimed platform or an actual rebuild
changes: COMMAND_IDS pins the 25 native commands, including clean and rebuild for every app, and each command is checked against its declared cwd and argv
observed_platform re-derives kernel, glibc, virtualization and CPU model/flags from the captured command logs
support_sources keys must equal SUPPORT_FILES and transferred consumer sources are re-hashed in their VM layout before any rebuild
host_kernel must equal the kernel observed by the source qualification, so the independent-VM check cannot rest on a free-form value
the 47-check acceptance text is read through each same-binary and rebuilt command record

rejected_stale_records.docs/evidence/M12-002/source-sdk/stable-: The record lacks helper_sources and its sdk_files closure omits tools/lib, so the hardened verifier rejects it until the profile is recaptured.
rejected_stale_records.docs/evidence/M12-002/source-sdk/candida: Same missing helper and tools/lib bindings; additionally the candidate SDK identity is not available.
rejected_stale_records.docs/evidence/M12-002/binary/report.json: The record has no helper_sources, no per-scan scanner digest, no installed consumer identity inventory and an ABI matrix without coordinate validation.
rejected_stale_records.docs/evidence/M12-002/platform/westmere-: The record has no transferred_sources inventory, so the transferred consumer sources cannot be shown to match the source qualification before rebuild.
rejected_stale_records.retained source-sdk stable-native: verify_command_inventory accepts the retained 39-command inventory and CA diagnostics, but verify_helper_sources rejects it: 'evidence helper inventory changed; recapture required' because the committed report records an empty helper_sources map.
rejected_stale_records.retained binary report: verify_command_inventory rejects it with 'scanner command bases are not unique' and verify_scan_verdicts with 'command evidence is missing: archive-0-headers'; the record predates the per-scan scanner command scheme and carries no consumer identities.
rejected_stale_records.retained platform westmere-glibc244: verify_commands accepts all 25 bound commands and observed_platform re-derives 'Westmere E56xx/L56xx/X56xx (Nehalem-C)' from the captured lscpu output, but the record still has no transferred_sources inventory.

missing_inputs.reason: Not present in the repository or anywhere on this host; it is not a tracked file. Every source, binary and deployment verification stops here.

missing_inputs.input: second supported STS SDK identity for the candidate-native profile
missing_inputs.reason: Only sts1.1.3 is installed and verified. The historical candidate 1.3.0-alpha.06 is not authorized for execution and relocating one SDK twice is not a second-version claim.

missing_inputs.input: native KVM guest with the selected glibc 2.44 runtime
missing_inputs.reason: Only the host kernel and a KVM device are present; no guest image, provenance or glibc runtime is retained, so the tested support cell cannot be re-executed.

red_green.observed: On the unmodified baseline every D1/D2/D3 guard is absent: no scan_fields or verify_consumers, a duplicate ABI coordinate is accepted, no scanner/helper binding in the binary report, no verify_helper_sources or command-inventory gate, and no transferred_sources in the platform report.
red_green.green: The same checks raise on the hardened verifiers: tools/tests/test_m12_002_source_sdk.py, tools/tests/test_m12_002_binary.py and tools/tests/test_m12_002_platform.py assert each rejection and pass in this revision.

repeated_capture.observed: The baseline lines keep an existing work/wirestack, so after a first capture a second selected archive is extracted but the previous tree stays installed: the reproduction reports scanned source marker=first and a STALE installed manifest against the second archive.
repeated_capture.green: install_selected_archive removes the previous tree and installs the selected archive, and verify refuses a report whose payload_sha256 is not the selected archive's; the same reproduction reports marker=second and PASS, and RepeatedCaptureInstallationTests asserts both rejections.

deployment_binding.observed: The baseline deployment collector compared only the production entries the retained profile recorded, so removing src/byte_span.cj from the profile passed; and it built Path(shutil.which("cc")) unconditionally, so an absent compiler raised TypeError instead of a controlled refusal.
deployment_binding.green: require_production_inventory compares the profile key set with release.production_sources(ROOT) before comparing bytes and rejects the removed entry; require_compiler_binding resolves the compiler through native_compiler_digest and refuses with "native C compiler cc is unavailable". tools/tests/test_m12_002_deployment.py asserts both, and the suite runs in contracts.
